title: [DocDB] TSAN race in DocDBRocksDBUtil::CotablePacking
body:
Jira Link: [DB-6017](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-6017)
### Description

https://detective-gcp.dev.yugabyte.com/stability/test?branch=master&build_type=all&class=DocOperationTest&fail_tag=tsan_race&name=MaxFileSizeWithWritesTrigger&platform=linux

https://detective-gcp.dev.yugabyte.com/stability/test?branch=master&build_type=all&class=DocOperationTest&fail_tag=tsan_race&name=EarlyFilesFilteredBeforeBigFile&platform=linux

My read of this is that we need atomic handling around `DocDBRocksDBUtil::doc_read_context_`, as it's a shared_ptr, but could be accessed across threads and first time created
